limits: Four affected hosts only; all four recorded current own bores per host are included. No full-frame rebuild, meshing, native FEA, global solve or load transfer.
Current baseline uses Boolean missing/added volume and bounds checks against frozen finished solids within numerical tolerance, not byte identity or a general topology-equivalence proof.
Both proposed scenarios replace eight current Z200 void occurrences from raw profiles. No old abandoned holes are added. Other eight affected-host bore occurrences remain at their current axes.

Queries use exact exported and reimported finished solids, full-circumference matching bore faces and one own-host target per annular skin. These are geometry observations, not allowable bearing lengths, actual contact pressure or strength.
Washer OD/ID are the recorded nominal scenarios. Delivered and all catalog-corner washers, installation tolerances and actual tools remain unverified.
Modeled timber screw pilots and owner countersinks are absent from the source solids and remain excluded. The separate bolt/screw-body clearance screen is not enlarged to cover unmodeled machining.

All authoritative geometry, axes, viewer and drilling instructions remain unchanged. Proposal adoption, changed-case actions and complete end/edge/group/net/splitting/restraint resistance remain open.
